name: VS340 XGA 3LCD Projector
description: Epson's VS330 XGA 3LCD Projector features a bright 2,800 lumens high-definition picture that everyone in your classroom will be able to see. A USB port offers quick plug-and-play setup; simply plug the projector into your computer and start presenting. An HDMI connection gives you high-definition video and audio through the same cable, and keystone correction makes it easy to correct the angles on your projected image. A power-saving eco mode gives you up to 10,000 hours of lamp life. Includes a remote control with batteries, power cable, computer cable, user manual CD and quick setup sheet.
